blocks.text: You can create a custom dataset for Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and use them to create SCADA/IoT decoys.

blocks.item: Locate an existing SCADA/IoT dataset based on the new custom dataset you want to create, and click the Download icon.
The SCADA/IoT dataset (.zip) is downloaded to your system.
Make the necessary changes to the SCADA/IoT dataset that you downloaded to meet your requirements.
In the SCADA/IoT Dataset Details window:
Name: Enter the name for the SCADA/IoT dataset.
Dataset/Templates (Zip File): Click Upload to upload the custom dataset you saved to your system.
The SCADA/IoT dataset is uploaded to the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal.

blocks.text: You can use the dataset in network decoys to deploy SCADA/IoT decoys. To learn more, see Configuring Services on a Network Decoy.
